period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention (for Q1, cumulative equals the discrete first-quarter figure) established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 31 March 2022'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (1st_quarter_2022.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 252,637,592,375 + Total Shareholders' Equity 22,884,822,891 = Total Assets 275,522,415,266); Profit after provision 1,198,350,799 - Contribution to NCC Bank's CSR Fund 11,983,508 = Profit before tax 1,186,367,291 - Provision for tax 496,352,465 = Profit after tax (full) 690,014,826. NEW STRUCTURAL ITEM this quarter: 'Interest on perpetual bonds' (BDT 110.19mn) is deducted from full Profit after tax to derive 'Net profit distributable to ordinary shareholders' (BDT 579,822,854), which is the basis for the reported EPS of 0.57 (579,822,854 / 1,016,870,967 ordinary shares outstanding) -- profit_after_tax_cumulative below is the FULL PAT (BDT 690.0mn), not the distributable-to-ordinary figure, per project convention of using the standard PAT line; the EPS figure itself, however, is the bank's own reported (distributable-basis) EPS. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2021' column shows Total Shareholders' Equity of BDT 22,196.36mn, matching the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2021_Q4.json exactly, but Total Assets of BDT 277,894.17mn versus BDT 275,037mn in that file (about 1.0% higher) and correspondingly higher Total Liabilities -- the discrepancy is asset/liability-side only, equity ties exactly; not further investigated.
